messages:
toni: quick pass on the staging base image turned up three items we should coordinate: world-writable /tmp, outdated openssl, and about a dozen tags without cosign attestations.

aditya: missing attestations will fail our deploy gate. do we know if cosign failed or the bake skipped signing?

toni: bake logs show cosign error: KMS keywrap denied. looks like the CI builder SA lost the kms.cryptoSign binding after the recent RBAC prune.

frank: who made the RBAC change? @kevin?

kevin: yeah that was me. I removed broad signer perms to reduce blast radius but didn't realize the bake called cosign as the builder SA. I can add a scoped kms.cryptoSign for the cosign key limited to ci-builder@redwood-prod. I'll add an expiry tag.

aditya: do that, and add a hard-fail verification in the bake so unsigned images don't slip through. small snippet to use: 

```
# bake step verify
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/cosign-key ${IMAGE} || (echo "UNSIGNED_IMAGE" && exit 1)
```

toni: +1. also security wants image-pull events in the audit timeline; right now we only see kubelet start/stop which makes forensics fuzzy.

frank: that's because our audit-exporter only forwards kubelet events. we can enable containerd event hooks in the audit sidecar and filter for pull/create events to avoid noise. sample config to test in staging: 

```
audit_exporter.containerd.enabled: true
audit_exporter.containerd.events: ["pull","create","delete"]
audit_exporter.filters:
  - event: pull
    fields: [image,registry,digest,node,principal]
shipper.url: https://audit-shipper.internal/ingest
```

aditya: test in staging with sampling=0.1 for the first 24h in case the shipper spikes.

kevin: will open the RBAC PR with expiry and rollback notes. please include explicit rollback commands in the PR description (how to remove the binding via gcloud and how to quarantine tags).

ton i: for migration of already-published unsigned images: rebuild+repush is preferred so provenance stamps are accurate. re-sign-in-place loses the build metadata that auditors care about.

frank: agreed. I'll own the rebuild runway. propose Tue 02:00-04:00 PT for canary, 1hr rollback window.

aditya: for rollback runbook include these steps: 1) `gcloud iam service-accounts remove-iam-policy-binding` to remove temporary sign permission, 2) call registry API to mark tags as quarantined (block deploys), 3) revert bake pipeline change and re-run smoke.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/iam/PR-5150. added expiry=7d and the rollback snippet. tagging @toni @aditya for quick approval.

audit-bot: scan-report: staging/base-image:4792001112 -> CIS failed (6), PROV failed (12). full report: https://ci.internal/scans/4792001112

ton i: thanks. frank I'll coordinate the rebuild and post results. :thumbsup:
